run.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: production desktop pet running sprite atlas.
Reference 1 original.png is the ONLY character identity: chibi girl, long straight black hair, oversized round black glasses, navy white-trim jacket over white shirt, loose light-blue patched jeans, white sneakers. Reference 2 is old FRONT-FACING walking atlas to REPLACE, not to copy its pose.
Create a 2 by 2 transparent sprite atlas, exactly FOUR consecutive running frames, equal cells, full body in every cell, no text, no background or floor. Crisp pixel-art edges matching original.
CRITICAL CHANGE: entire character turned 45 degrees toward image LEFT, three-quarter side view; face, glasses bridge, chest, hips and shoes all oriented diagonally left, NOT front-facing marching. Eyes look along travel toward left. Show asymmetric foreshortening of glasses and shoulder widths. Cute gentle running leaning slightly forward, bent elbows, opposite arm/leg swings.
Frame order row-major: 1 left leg reaches forward/right back, 2 left support/right knee passes, 3 right leg reaches forward/left back, 4 right support/left knee passes. Same body proportions and head scale, same foot baseline and pelvis location, modest vertical bob only, subtle hair trailing toward right. Shoes must read from side rather than front soles. Do not duplicate the same anatomical support leg. Keep both legs distinguishable. Keep outfit and face identity exactly; no new accessories.
True transparent background, generous padding each cell, no overlaps.

peek.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: transparent 2x2 atlas, four equal sprite cells for a screen-edge desktop companion.
Input 1 original reference is character identity. Input 2 peek-v051.png is edit target. Keep long black hair, round black glasses, navy white-trim jacket, cute same chibi face, linework, head size, hand placement and crop.
CHANGE ONLY the head orientation / gaze of the peek target: she must look DIRECTLY OUT OF SCREEN AT THE VIEWER, as if making eye contact with the person at computer. Both eyes symmetric and pupils centered on viewer. Face nearly frontal, not looking left or right. No sideways pupils. Slightly curious affectionate smile. Body stays at slight angle and BOTH hands grip the same invisible vertical edge on LEFT side of each cell. Hands aligned to same x line from frame to frame. Head extends toward right of grip so she peeks out into screen. This will be mirrored for right-edge use, so eye contact MUST remain neutral/front-facing after flipping.
Frame1 open eyes, frame2 blink closed, frame3 open eyes tiny head tilt, frame4 open eyes gentle smile. Same head scale and identical body and grip placement all four cells, no zoom. Bust only, long hair hanging down. No actual screen, no wall or line, no text, no props. True transparent background. Preserve style and outfit from original reference.
